title: A Vigilante
description: A vigilante helps victims escape their domestic abusers.

title: The Contractor
description: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

title: Criminal
description: Hoping to stop a diabolical plot, the CIA implants the memories and skills of a dead agent (Ryan Reynolds) into the mind of a dangerous convict (Kevin Costner).

title: Erased
description: A former agent (Aaron Eckhart) of the CIA and his estranged daughter (Liana Liberato) go on the run after his employers target them for assassination.

title: From Paris With Love
description: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.

title: The Courier

title: Django Unchained
description: A former slave (Jamie Foxx) joins forces with the German bounty hunter (Christoph Waltz) who freed him and helps hunt down the South's most-wanted criminals, all in the hope of finding his long-lost wife (Kerry Washington).

title: The Hateful Eight
description: While seeking shelter from a blizzard in post-Civil War Wyoming, two bounty hunters (Samuel L. Jackson, Kurt Russell), a fugitive prisoner (Jennifer Jason Leigh) and a man (Walton Goggins) who claims to be a sheriff encounter four strangers.
